description: Update a General Inventory product by productId or sku: name, SKU, ASIN, barcode, category, prices, manufactured flag and BOM (bomComponents replaces the whole BOM; hasBom:false clears it). Stock is changed only via adjust_inventory_stock. Supports confirm (false = dry-run preview).

bomComponents.description: BOM lines (replaces the whole BOM when given). Components must already exist in this farm's inventory.

productId.description: Inventory product ID of the component (or use sku)

quantity.description: Quantity of this component per unit produced (> 0)

sku.description: SKU of the component inventory product (or use productId)

confirm.description: Set to true to commit, false for dry-run preview

hasBom.description: True for manufactured items that have a BOM recipe

newSku.description: New SKU (must be unique in the farm)

sku.description: Current SKU of the product to update (or use productId)

unit.description: Unit of measure (e.g. each, pair, lb)

name: update_inventory_product
